home.name: Prati home base (near Ottaviano / Lepanto)
home.summary: One Airbnb for the week — lift or ground floor, washer, kitchen, crib. Address TBD.

places.name: Rome Fiumicino Airport (FCO)
places.summary: Arrival Mon Nov 16 ~7:00am · Departure Tue Nov 24 AZ 618 10:10am.

places.name: St Peter’s Square
places.summary: Colonnade, obelisk, security queues. Meeting point for the audience.

places.name: St Peter’s Basilica
places.summary: Free entry. Pietà, baldachin, nave. Skip the dome with baby/toddler.

places.name: Bronze Door (Portone di Bronzo)
places.summary: Ticket pickup for the General Audience. Apostolic Palace, right colonnade of St Peter’s Square.

places.name: Pantheon
places.summary: Vast round hall with an open oculus. Timed tickets; under-18 free but still need a ticket.

places.name: Santa Maria sopra Minerva
places.summary: Gothic basilica; Michelangelo’s Christ; St Catherine’s tomb. Usually opens mid-morning.

places.name: San Luigi dei Francesi
places.summary: Caravaggio’s St Matthew cycle in the Contarelli Chapel. Free; midday closure.

places.name: Trevi Fountain
places.summary: Street view free. Inner basin has controlled entry. Quick photos — don’t linger.

places.name: Spanish Steps
places.summary: Piazza di Spagna and the steps to Trinità dei Monti.

places.name: Castel Sant’Angelo
places.summary: Hadrian’s tomb turned fortress. Stairs; exterior + bridge is enough if the museum is too much.

places.name: Colosseum
places.summary: Timed entry. Standard tiers — not arena/underground. Book all nine ~30 days out.

places.name: Arch of Constantine
places.summary: Free exterior stop next to the Colosseum.

places.name: Roman Forum
places.summary: Combined ticket with Colosseum area. Uneven stones — carrier often better than stroller.

places.name: Santa Maria Maggiore
places.summary: Papal basilica with golden mosaics. Free entry.

places.name: San Giovanni in Laterano
places.summary: Cathedral of Rome. Huge nave and Apostle statues.

places.name: Scala Santa
places.summary: Holy Stairs (kneeling) / side stairs for walking. Brief look with toddlers.

places.name: Santa Croce in Gerusalemme
places.summary: Optional short stop. Relic chapel may be closed for renovation — check first.

places.name: Isola Tiberina / San Bartolomeo
places.summary: Island stroll and brief church peek. Prefer taxi over long cobbles with a stroller.

places.name: Glass Hostaria
places.summary: Anniversary dinner pick. Vicolo del Cinque 58, Trastevere. Wed–Sun dinner. No table held yet.

places.name: L’Arcangelo
places.summary: Walkable Prati alternate for anniversary dinner. Confirm November hours by phone.

places.name: Despar Prati
places.summary: Supermarket at Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano. Grocery stop for apartment breakfasts.

places.name: Mercato Rionale Prati
places.summary: Neighborhood market in Piazza dell’Unità, Prati. Fruit, veg, and deli counters for the apartment.

places.name: Il Matriciano
places.summary: Classic Roman trattoria in Prati, Via dei Gracchi 55. Closed Wednesday; Sunday dinner closed.

places.name: Osteria dei Gracchi
places.summary: Neighborhood osteria at Via dei Gracchi 19, Prati. Roman cooking near Ottaviano.

places.name: Trattoria Micci
places.summary: Prati trattoria-pizzeria since 1936, Via Andrea Doria 55 a/b. Closed Monday.

places.name: La Campana
places.summary: Historic Roman restaurant (from 1518) on Vicolo della Campana, near the Pantheon. Closed Monday.

places.name: Dar Bruttone Rione Monti
places.summary: Roman cooking on Via dei Serpenti 113, Monti, near the Colosseum.

places.name: Osteria Al Vicolo 9
places.summary: Monti osteria at Vicolo dei Serpenti 9. Closed Sunday.

places.name: Osteria Faleria
places.summary: Roman/Lazio osteria near San Giovanni, Via Faleria 47. Family-friendlier than a tiny tasting room for 9.

places.name: Pepe San Giovanni
places.summary: Family-scale restaurant/pizzeria at Via Gallia 103, near the Lateran.

places.name: Al Pompiere
places.summary: Historic Roman trattoria in the Ghetto, Piazza delle Cinque Scole 28. Closed Tuesday; Sunday lunch.
